device.basis: Boot-source strap word; the control words at 0xff90e400 and 0xfa140000 belong to the same block and reset to 0. Setup samples bit 0 and, set, initializes the serial-flash controller (the direct-flash path; catalog/firmware/xe5/1.12/xp5-boot/setup-handoff.toml). The X-E5 1.12 loader path writes 0xff90e400 through 0x1498ac4.
